author: Codex / GPT-6 Astra, bounded independent synthesis agent
scope: Read both complete campaign title/question inventories and original descriptions for featured choices; no new literature search or full-text review. Recommendations are an editorial browsing aid, not new scientific validation.
retention_policy: Retain all 200 source ideas under A-Dxx-xx and F-Dxx-xx. Add related links and distinguish shared tasks from alternative experiments. Do not silently delete variants or merge incompatible numeric scores.
featured_explanation: Twelve different places to begin: six from each original collection. This is a balanced selection to browse, not a combined ranking. Each starts with a small learning exercise; a paper requires a sharper question, a literature check, and convincing results.

featured.title: A correct final answer can hide collateral edits
featured.display_title: Did the agent quietly change something else?
featured.why_featured: A visible, everyday failure and an offline first exercise: spot changes to fields that should have stayed untouched.
featured.first_step: Make a tiny appointment table and label 30 example edits as allowed or accidental; then write checks that catch them.
featured.readiness: Astra provisionally eligible. Learn assertions and sets; a mentor checks what each task is allowed to change.
featured.publication_condition: Show a real blind spot in an existing evaluator. A made-up failing example alone is insufficient.

featured.title: Agent locates the 2D Ising model's critical temperature
featured.display_title: Can an AI choose better physics experiments?
featured.why_featured: A natural AI–physics pair project with a known reference answer and a shared picture to reproduce first.
featured.first_step: Reproduce a small Ising magnetization curve with a checked simulator before giving an agent control of temperature and sample count.
featured.readiness: Fable ungated, freshman pair, shallow audit twist-ok. Needs a Monte Carlo tutorial, energy-convention checks, and uncertainty estimates; allow warm-up time before agent integration.
featured.publication_condition: Compare compute needed for a target accuracy against strong classical adaptive and fixed-grid baselines. The agent may already know the textbook temperature; test experiment choice, not recall.

featured.title: How many coupling bits preserve the answer?
featured.display_title: When does rounding change a physics machine's answer?
featured.why_featured: Small systems can be checked exhaustively on a laptop, so beginners can know whether their result is correct.
featured.first_step: List all spin states of a tiny Ising problem and compare its best answer before and after rounding the coupling strengths.
featured.readiness: Astra provisionally eligible. No hardware or neural-network training; mentor checks the energy formula and degeneracies.
featured.publication_condition: Go beyond known precision sensitivity to a useful instance-specific bound or a sharp counterexample.

featured.title: Sumplete: solving the ChatGPT-invented NP-complete grid puzzle
featured.display_title: Can an AI solve a puzzle associated with ChatGPT?
featured.why_featured: A playable task with exact answer checking and a clear progression from a tiny solver to controlled model comparisons.
featured.first_step: Solve a small row-and-column-sum puzzle by hand, then write a checker and an exhaustive solver for tiny grids.
featured.readiness: Fable ungated, freshman, shallow audit twist-ok. The puzzle generator and solver must be validated; verify uniqueness only when the experiment requires it.
featured.publication_condition: Generic puzzle benchmarks are crowded. Fresh instances reduce memorization concerns but do not prove the task is uncontaminated or new.

featured.title: Which logical words survive memory compression?
featured.display_title: Does an AI memory forget words like 'except'?
featured.why_featured: Short instructions and exact sets make subtle memory mistakes understandable without advanced ML.
featured.first_step: Write examples such as 'invite everyone except Sam' and check which decisions remain correct after shortening the instructions.
featured.readiness: Astra provisionally eligible. Mentor supplies five checked templates; the comparison must give structured and prose memories equal information budgets.
featured.publication_condition: Measure a specific quantifier failure and a controlled remedy beyond the established benefits of structured memory.

featured.title: Do noisy coupled oscillators sample a Boltzmann distribution?
featured.display_title: Do noisy oscillators explore the right answers?
featured.why_featured: Tiny exact distributions make the difference between finding one good answer and sampling fairly tangible.
featured.first_step: Compute the exact probabilities of a tiny Ising system and reproduce them with a standard sampler before trying oscillator dynamics.
featured.readiness: Fable ungated, freshman pair, shallow audit twist-ok. Mentor must specify and validate the phase-to-spin model and numerical integration; arbitrary binned Kuramoto dynamics need not implement an Ising sampler.
featured.publication_condition: A useful result needs a mechanism for sampling failure, sufficient mixing checks, and justified temperature calibration. A mismatch by itself does not guarantee a paper.

featured.title: A split builder that keeps noisy copies together
featured.display_title: Did the model learn, or see a copy of the answer?
featured.why_featured: A visual synthetic-data exercise exposes an important real-world mistake using distances and simple classifiers.
featured.first_step: Generate measurements and slightly altered copies, then show how a random train/test split can make prediction look too easy.
featured.readiness: Astra provisionally eligible. Mentor supplies an ancestry generator. A nearest-precedent literature check remains required.
featured.publication_condition: Deduplication and grouped splitting are mature; demonstrate an improved tradeoff between contamination and falsely merging rare examples.

featured.title: Phase diagram of particle-life clustering
featured.display_title: Watch simple particles build moving worlds
featured.why_featured: Immediate visual feedback offers a gentle entry into simulation while leaving room for careful quantitative physics.
featured.first_step: Run a small two-species particle simulation and measure the sizes of the clusters it forms.
featured.readiness: Fable ungated, freshman, shallow audit twist-ok. Fix the force rule, boundary conditions, and integrator; test that behavior survives smaller time steps.
featured.publication_condition: Attractive animations are a learning result. A paper needs a robust, narrowly defined transition and finite-size analysis; no universality claim from one fitted curve.

featured.title: A useful lifetime for social confirmation
featured.display_title: When should a repeated rumor stop counting?
featured.why_featured: A simple event-list simulation connects timing, repeated evidence, and collective decisions without collecting personal data.
featured.first_step: Simulate people adopting a message after two confirmations, then vary how long an old confirmation remains valid.
featured.readiness: Astra provisionally eligible. Learn lists, probability, and plotting; a mentor checks timestamp and synthetic source-label definitions.
featured.publication_condition: Keep contacts and sources matched while varying timing. Results concern the stated simulation, not demonstrated human behavior.

featured.title: The boiling frog: detection threshold for gradual tool-output drift
featured.display_title: How long does an agent miss a slowly drifting tool?
featured.why_featured: A controllable fake sensor produces a clear plot of when answers become wrong and when the system reports trouble.
featured.first_step: Build a numeric mock tool, add a growing bias, and define a task with an exactly checkable answer before running a model.
featured.readiness: Fable ungated, freshman, shallow audit twist-ok. Define a measurable warning output and validate it; keyword hits do not establish awareness. Do not require API log probabilities before checking availability.
featured.publication_condition: Compare against a suitable classical drift detector. A prompt-injection detector is not automatically a meaningful upper bound for numeric drift.

featured.title: A tuner that knows when to stay quiet
featured.display_title: Build a music tuner that admits uncertainty
featured.why_featured: Students can hear the problem and start with synthesized notes and known answers on an ordinary laptop.
featured.first_step: Generate a note with a sharp onset and compare short-window and long-window pitch estimates as it settles.
featured.readiness: Astra provisionally eligible. Mentor provides a windowing example; no hardware or participants needed. Nearest-precedent check remains required.
featured.publication_condition: Existing tuner confidence thresholds may match the proposed method. Test accuracy, rejected frames, and latency together.

featured.title: TESS flare-energy power laws vs. stellar rotation
featured.display_title: Find stellar flares in space-telescope data
featured.why_featured: A route beyond the lab's main topics with real public observations and a concrete first plot.
featured.first_step: Download one curated star's light curve, inspect candidate flares, and compare detections with a published catalog.
featured.readiness: Fable ungated but unaudited; one judge calls the broad relation already studied. Needs a curated starter star and data-wrangling support. Published flare catalogs are references, not exact complete ground truth.
featured.publication_condition: The rotation–flare relation is established. First treat this as a replication; seek a justified sample, completeness correction, or methodological extension before promising novelty.

overlap_clusters.label: Finding minima versus sampling fairly
overlap_clusters.explanation: All compare empirical states with a Boltzmann target. A-D04-10 changes postprocessing; F-D05-09 changes annealing schedules; A-D04-04 probes hidden within-energy bias; A-D04-05 tests calibration transfer; F-D05-04/06/06-10 change sampler implementation. Share exact-enumeration tools and distribution diagnostics, keep experiments distinct.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: No exact cross-source duplicate established; potentially one coordinated sampling project.

overlap_clusters.label: Fair comparison of Ising solvers
overlap_clusters.explanation: Astra isolates integration-step effects at matched work; Fable compares algorithms after budgeted hyperparameter tuning. Step-size control can become a required component of the broader race.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Keep both; offer the Astra scope as a diagnostic within the Fable project.

overlap_clusters.label: When and how noise helps an anneal
overlap_clusters.explanation: Noise timing, critical slowing, avalanches, and schedule-dependent sampling share trajectories but test different mechanisms.

overlap_clusters.label: An agent chooses the next experiment
overlap_clusters.explanation: Fable supplies concrete physics worlds; Astra isolates repeat/new tradeoffs, decision-relevant information, batches, and enabling actions. Combine one physics world with one design question before expanding. Fable's several discovery tasks are a ladder, not automatically separate papers.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Retain each as a variant and link to a shared experimental-design family.

overlap_clusters.label: When the scientific model is wrong or undecidable
overlap_clusters.explanation: Reserved diagnostic queries, exact observational equivalence, the wrong transition model, and a broken small-angle approximation all examine justified scientific conclusions. Exact equivalence is fundamentally different from a model that can be falsified with the available tests.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Do not merge the impossibility task with model-mismatch tasks.

overlap_clusters.label: Detecting and correcting a drifting instrument
overlap_clusters.explanation: Fable measures silent drift detection; Astra chooses reference measurements to separate instrument drift from true change. They can share a simulator but require different outputs and baselines.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Near-overlap, preserve detection and recalibration scopes.

overlap_clusters.label: Where should an agent check its work?
overlap_clusters.explanation: Astra chooses verification calls and audits collateral writes; Fable studies fault propagation, checkpoint spacing, and model cost. A common stateful toy environment can support these without asserting they are the same question.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Coordinate infrastructure; retain intervention and metric distinctions.

overlap_clusters.label: Errors that persist in agent memory
overlap_clusters.explanation: Quantifier loss, repeated summarization, missing stored evidence, deliberate false facts, and long-horizon context growth are different causes. Use common histories and exact checks while separating corruption from omission.

overlap_clusters.label: A team can repeat the same mistake
overlap_clusters.explanation: All question gains from more nominal votes. Astra exposes ancestry, preserves independent estimates, or selects committees; Fable measures majority-vote scaling and repeated-sample cost. Evidence dependence is shared; proposed interventions differ.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Best treated as a coordinated correlated-evidence family, not five independent novelty claims.

overlap_clusters.label: When the grader is the problem
overlap_clusters.explanation: Astra targets false acceptance despite unintended state changes; Fable targets false rejection of correct but differently formatted answers.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Complementary evaluator audits; preserve both directions of error.

overlap_clusters.label: How many repetitions make a result trustworthy?
overlap_clusters.explanation: Fable estimates benchmark variance versus repeat count. Astra allocates a fixed fit budget between split and seed repetitions while charging for a pilot. Shared statistical warm-up, distinct optimization problem.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Potential common bootcamp with a later allocation extension.

overlap_clusters.label: Local cells decide a global majority
overlap_clusters.explanation: Both use cellular density classification. Astra adds refractory memory under asynchronous clocks; Fable uses an LLM to search rule tables and studies interpretation. This is the clearest shared task across campaigns.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Retain method variants; coordinate baseline rules and exact scoring.

overlap_clusters.label: Cellular patterns repair damage
overlap_clusters.explanation: Astra enforces material conservation or a growth-stop signal. Fable measures regeneration scaling or controller robustness. Visual similarity does not make their conservation assumptions or output metrics equivalent.

overlap_clusters.label: Self-organizing particles
overlap_clusters.explanation: Astra introduces history-dependent type switching to repair boundaries; Fable maps clustering/traveling behavior of a fixed interaction rule.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Different dynamics and question; keep as related approaches.

overlap_clusters.label: Keeping possibilities alive during evolution
overlap_clusters.explanation: Reward curricula, dormant phenotype archives, and novelty selection all affect evolutionary diversity, but Astra's digital organisms and Fable's Lenia populations need different implementations.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Do not force a code-level or novelty merge.

overlap_clusters.label: Computation with one dynamical node
overlap_clusters.explanation: Astra isolates masks, reset pulses, and virtual-node sampling; Fable builds a physical delay reservoir. Simulation studies may prepare hardware work; hardware has additional access, cost, and supervision requirements.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Keep hardware clearly distinct from laptop-only variants.

overlap_clusters.label: Traffic flow in simple models
overlap_clusters.explanation: Astra staggers route recommendations after demand shocks; Fable compares stop-and-go waves with a cellular traffic model or observations. Route choice and within-road jams are different mechanisms.
overlap_clusters.duplicate_disposition: Related browsing link only; not a duplicate.

student_copy.hero: Find a question you want to spend time with.
student_copy.intro: Explore 200 project sketches in AI, physics, music, ecology, and more. You do not need research experience to start. Every project begins with something small to learn or build.
choose_steps: Pick a topic that makes you curious. Your major does not limit your choices.
Read the first step and the resources. Start with a small plot, simulation, puzzle, or checker you can understand.
Save a few favorites, including one outside your usual interests. These are interests, not commitments.
Discuss a short starter exercise with a mentor. Choose a project after trying the first step.
student_copy.paper_path: A first result is a learning milestone. A publication comes later if the question is still open and the evidence is strong; none of these sketches guarantees a paper.
student_copy.score_note: The two collections used different scoring systems. Original assessments are shown as context; their numbers should not be compared directly.
student_copy.related_note: Related ideas may share a simulator or ask different versions of a question. Explore both before choosing a scope.
student_copy.readiness_note: Some sketches need a mentor-provided example, data, hardware, or a sharper research question. Check the preparation notes before starting.

implementation_caveats.note: Do not label the 12 featured choices as the combined top 12 or sort all 200 on normalized source scores; normalization would not align their different criteria.
Preserve source readiness, risk, and audit status. An unaudited idea is not a confirmed open problem; publication venues and first-month timelines are aspirations.

Its broadcast protocol does not establish the claimed logarithmic lower bound. One unrestricted broadcast from every agent can reveal all links. Require a precisely specified communication/computation model and mentor verification before presenting a theory comparison as valid.
A published CNN flare catalog is an imperfect reference set, not exact ground truth. Detection completeness and energy estimates require checking.
Phase binning of an arbitrary noisy Kuramoto system does not by itself yield an Ising Boltzmann target. The phase-to-spin mapping and assumed stationary distribution must be justified.

A keyword flag is an observable response, not proof of awareness; prompt-injection detection is not an established upper bound for numeric drift detection. Audit-suggested log probabilities may be unavailable.

Newly released exams or generated instances reduce some memorization concerns but do not make contamination structurally impossible. Related questions, task templates, solutions, and training dates remain uncertain.
Human-participant studies need appropriate consent and institutional handling before recruitment; offer nonparticipant starter exercises where feasible.
Known textbook answers may already be in a model's memory. Evaluate the choices and evidence under a controlled task, not merely whether the model states the known answer.
Post-audit replacement; only a correction scoring pass, no idea-specific adversarial audit. The synthesis link is not a new audit.
